name: Paper World
summary: A handmade craft-table diorama: stop-motion paper puppets with cream sticker rims and brass split pins on layered kraft, felt and newsprint.
description: Everything looks cut from real craft materials and laid on a table under one warm top-left lamp: kraft paper, corrugated cardboard, green felt, a carpet of cut paper leaves and torn newspaper scraps, crossed by a path of cardstock stepping stones. Characters are jointed paper puppets built from separate cut pieces, each with a cream sticker rim, paper grain and its own soft plum-brown drop shadow, held together by brass split pins, and they move like hand-moved stop-motion puppets: held poses on twos, pop-up cards that hinge upright, tissue spirits dangling on threads. Nothing has an ink outline. Figures rip along a torn edge and fall flat; impacts snap open card starbursts and shed two-sided paper scraps and confetti.
avoidFor: bullet-hell shooters with hundreds of tiny projectiles
grim realism or horror that should feel threatening

difficulty.why: Every new asset is a puppet of many separate cut pieces, each needing its own rim, grain, light gradient, offset shadow and split pins, plus baked frames per facing; new ground materials need per-pixel signed-distance shading and are performance-hungry.

technique.resolution: Native resolution with smoothing. Sprite pieces are baked at 4 canvas px per world unit (K = 4), ground decals at 6 px/unit, ground materials at 2.5 texels/unit and the ground chunk raster is capped at 2.5 px/unit (groundResMax).
technique.summary: Every visible object is a stack of baked cut pieces: a flat-coloured shape, dilated into a cream sticker rim, multiplied with a paper-grain texture and a top-left light gradient, then composed with a blurred plum-brown copy of itself offset right-down. Layered pieces plus held stop-motion poses (secondary motion stepped at 12 fps) produce a physical, hand-animated paper diorama.
technique.linework: No dark outlines. Silhouettes are separated by a cream rim (#fbf6ea) 0.3–0.6 world units wide made by morphological dilation, plus soft brown offset shadows. Fine 'pencil' details only: rgba(120,45,10,0.28) or rgba(120,90,50,0.35) strokes 0.18–0.22 units, round caps/joins; dashed stitch lines 0.2 units [0.55, 0.45].
technique.shading: Flat fills per piece. Volume comes from stacking several flat layers that each cast a 0.3/0.4-unit offset shadow (rgba(70,25,5,0.28) inside round lobes) on the layer below, a darker lower half on leaves, a lighter front panel on clothing, and a diagonal source-atop gradient per piece: rgba(255,250,232,a) at 0, transparent at 0.45, rgba(50,25,10,1.2a) at 1 (a ≈ 0.1). Shadows are hue-shifted: cool plum-brown rgb(44,24,34) against the warm lamp-lit paper.
technique.lighting: One warm lamp at the top-left. All shadows fall right-down in plum-brown rgb(44,24,34): pieces inside a puppet (0.42, 0.55) units, whole puppets (0.9, 1.1) blur 0.7, ground sheets (1.0–1.7, 1.3–2.2) blur 1.1–1.9, upright props get a skewed projected cast shadow. Carved faces, lanterns and the golem core glow through cut-out holes with additive orange light that flickers on twos. Warm brown vignette at the screen edges.
technique.texture: Procedural paper grain on every piece (256 px tile: 50/50 cream and brown noise at alpha ≤ 22/255 plus 520 short curved fibres), kraft fibres running horizontally, curly felt hairs, cardboard corrugation ridges every 3.2 units, newspaper columns with word bars and halftone pictures.

paletteRules: Muted, slightly dusty craft-paper colours; nothing neon. Saturation tops out at pumpkin #e57d2c and teal #36a596.
Ground is ~80% warm browns, tans and felt greens; characters supply the saturated accents (pumpkin, aubergine, mustard).
Shadows are always plum-brown rgb(44,24,34) at partial alpha: a cool, slightly violet shade under warm lamp-lit paper, never black or grey.
Every cut piece carries the cream rim #fbf6ea; the rim colour is the brightest common value on screen.
Darkest value is ink brown #3b2a26 / aubergine deep #2e1530; pure #000 never appears.
Glow colours (#fffbe0 → #ffe066 → #ffa21e) only appear inside cut-out holes and as additive halos.
Confetti and celebration paper use the seven accent colours #e57d2c #d6a43a #36a596 #c4432f #9c629a #f2e7cf #76a54e and nothing else.

typography.role: Numbers, card titles, floating numbers, counters
typography.css: font: 400 22px/1 'Gochi Hand', cursive; color: #3b2a26; background: #fbf6ea; padding: 0 9px; transform: rotate(-2deg); box-shadow: 2px 3px 4px rgba(44,24,34,.4);

font: 400 74px/1 'Caveat Brush', cursive; color: #e57d2c; transform: rotate(-3deg); text-shadow: -3px -3px 0 #fbf6ea, 3px -3px 0 #fbf6ea, -3px 3px 0 #fbf6ea, 3px 3px 0 #fbf6ea, 0 4px 0 #fbf6ea, 7px 10px 6px rgba(20,10,5,.55);

world.summary: A craft table seen from above: large organic sheets of different materials stacked on a kraft-paper base, each casting a soft plum-brown shadow on what lies beneath and showing a darker side thickness at its lower edge. A meandering path of cardstock stepping stones leads across the regions; props stand in small composed groups with baked litter around them; paper flowers gather in a few meadow drifts instead of being sprinkled evenly.
layers: Kraft paper base #a87c54 → #b4885c (two tints mixed by low-frequency noise), mottled, horizontal fibres, dark and light specks
Corrugated cardboard sheets #c49c6c with ridges every 3.2 units, thickness 1.0, shadow offset (1.4, 1.8) soft 1.5 alpha 0.40; side face shows flutes
Felt sheets #607c46 → #768442 (noise mix), curly hair texture, thickness 1.4, shadow (1.7, 2.2) soft 1.9 alpha 0.42
Moss felt patches #868440, thickness 0.9, shadow (1.2, 1.6), cream running-stitch checker 1.55–2.15 units inside the edge

Leaf carpet: ~2100 rasterised cut leaves (oval, maple, wavy) in autumn reds/oranges/ochres, each shadowing the leaves under it; edge made of whole leaves, loose leaves blown off up to 9 units beyond it
Newspaper scraps #ddd5c0 on top: printed columns, headlines, halftone pictures, a 0.55–1.0 unit white torn core #f6eedc, thickness 0.35

Stepping-stone path: the zero line of a slow noise field (scale 1/540) meanders across felt, kraft and card; one grey cardstock stone per 10-unit cell, staggered left/right like footsteps and turned along the path, pebbles and felt tufts at its sides; skipped on leaves and newsprint; props keep 13 units and big decals 22 units away from it
Felt-edge grass fringe in runs (noise-gated, not evenly) along the meadow cut edge
Flower drifts: punched paper flowers only where a 170-unit fbm exceeds 0.6, 4–13 per drift with a dense centre and thin rim, one or two flower kinds per drift, two tufts at the base

Prop litter baked under every prop site: leaf litter in the crown colours thrown to the shadow side of trees, straw around hay, pebbles and a flower at gravestones, a curling paper vine with leaves linking each pumpkin patch, tufts along fences
Rare large decals (170-unit cells): lace doily, coffee ring, folds and stamped arrows on kraft/card; a very sparse layer of single buttons, tape, staples and confetti by region
Compositing: colour × (0.93 + 0.13·noise), warm per-channel shadow from upper layers ×(1−0.86k, 1−0.97k, 1−k), extra ambient-occlusion darkening within 2.4 units outside each sheet edge

characters.summary: Jointed stop-motion paper puppets. Each body part (legs, torso, arms, head, stem, scarf) is a separate baked cut piece with rim, grain and light, rotated around its own pivot and drawn back-to-front; every piece drops a blurred plum-brown shadow (0.42, 0.55 units, alpha 0.34) onto the pieces below. Brass split pins mark visible joints. All poses are pre-baked as held frames (main character 34 per facing: 8 walk, 8 walk-and-throw, 8 breathing idle, 4 look-around, 3 dash, 2 toss, 1 hurt; creatures 8 or 6) with a puppet shadow (0.9, 1.1, blur 0.7, alpha 0.3) and a cream flash copy.
rules: Main character ~18 units wide and ~30 tall (frame 36 × 44 units, feet at 18, 40), drawn at 1.08 scale: a puppet in an aubergine tunic #6e3c6d with a green striped scarf whose tail streams behind, a big round carved pumpkin head (~19 units) with a curly stem, storybook proportions.

Walk = 4 key poses per step (contact, down, passing, up) mirrored for the second step; the hip drops 0.4 on the down pose and rises 0.6 on the up pose, the body piece squashes 3.5% on the down pose; the head lags the hip by one pose, scarf tail and stem by two (overlapping action).
Faces are cut-out holes (triangle eyes, jagged mouth) showing glowing paper: dark #3a1408 base, radial gradient #fffbe0 → #ffe066 → #ffa21e shifted (0.32, 0.45) so the dark cut edge shows top-left.
Round forms are 3–5 stacked ellipse lobes in deep/dark/mid/light of one hue, each with its own small shadow rgba(70,25,5,0.28) offset (0.3, 0.4).

Small creature, two designed variants: a lanky three-leaf root bulb with an aubergine #6e3c6d cap, and a squat one with a plum #843a63 cap, one big leaf and a curled paper sprout. Cream bulb #efe2b8 → #dcc68a, torn cap over a white core, glowing orange cut eyes, aubergine paper-strip brows; frame 32 × 38.

Fast creature: a translucent tissue-paper ghost gathered into a twisted knot with three flared tips (its silhouette feature) and hanging from a thin thread #5a4658; hollow eyes, gaping mouth, frost sequins; no hard shadow.

Large creature: a cardboard golem (frame 66 × 70) with a torn painted top exposing a corrugated band, masking-tape patches, staples, tube arms with root fingers, a leaf crown and a glowing star-shaped core hole.
Every piece has a rim (0.35–0.45 thin, 0.55–0.6 large); each creature type keeps one dominant colour and a distinct silhouette so crowds do not merge into a white mass.

props.summary: Stand-up cut-outs on a kraft fold tab, composed like puppet frames (part shadows (0.55, 0.7)), each casting a skewed, blurred projected shadow that falls right-down from the foot: autumn round trees, felt pines, a bare tree, pumpkins, mushrooms, gravestones, picket fences, hay mounds and spinning pinwheels, placed as small designed groups.
rules: Every prop stands on a fold tab: a trapezoid of #c9a275 (grey #b3aebb for stones) with a darker crease band.
Cast shadow: silhouette skewed with setTransform(1, 0, −0.42, −0.26), faded 1 → 0.45 with distance, blurred 1.4 units, a dark contact blob at the foot; drawn at alpha 0.78.

Round trees: tapered trunk #76503a with cut branches, three scalloped crowns (11/9/8 bumps) in autumn triplets such as #9a6a2a / #c8962e / #e2be5a, brass pin on the front crown; 0–2 mushrooms gather on the shady right side.
Pines come as stands: one tall felt pine (four zig-zag tiers #445e34 → #859a4e) with one or two younger pines at 0.62–0.8 scale behind it; bare tree: dark trunk #5e4034 with hanging paper leaves.

Pumpkins: five concentric ellipses (orange, mustard or cream colourways) in patches of 1–3 joined by a curling paper vine; mushrooms: a spotted red pair, a tall tan parasol, a huddle of small cream caps.

Gravestones in rows of 1–3, grey #9b97a3, arched or cross-shaped, moss-felt scallop at the base; picket fences: card pickets #c49c6c / #cba574 on #96714a rails with masking tape; hay mounds of 140 straw strokes; pinwheels with four blades and a brass hub pin, spinning 1.2–2.8 rad/s.
Trees, pines and bare trees rock on their fold tab ±0.014 rad, stepped on twos with a phase taken from their position, so a grove never moves in lock-step.

Props are chosen by region (felt: trees, pumpkins, hay, pinwheels; moss felt: pine stands, mushrooms; leaves: bare trees, gravestones; card: fences) on 128-unit cells at 50% chance and are y-sorted with the characters.

effects.name: Card starburst (core flash)
effects.how: A cut card star (mustard-light with a hot-glow centre; red #e0604a for the main character) snaps open with easeOutBack over the first 40% of 0.15 s, then shrinks away; stepped on twos and drawn with its own offset part shadow.

effects.name: Petal ring (main shape)
effects.how: Nine cut paper petals in the source figure’s colours burst outwards in a ring (radius 0.25 → 1.2 × size, easeOut), each folding over as it flies (y-scale |cos|, back colour × 0.72, every third petal cream); 0.36 s, 0.45 s for large figures.

effects.name: Paper scraps (debris and residue)
effects.how: Irregular 5–7-gon scraps in the figure’s palette (2–3 per impact, 6–16 when a figure is destroyed) fly with gravity 70, drag 2.2, spin ±6 rad/s and flip (y-scale max(0.18, |cos(rot·1.7)|), back colour shown when cos < 0), with a 0.16-unit cream edge; their ground shadow tightens as they land and they lie flat for the rest of their 0.9–1.6 s life.

effects.name: Tear-apart
effects.how: A destroyed card creature rips top first along fixed 8-point zig-zag tear paths into two pieces (three for large figures, with a middle strip) that slide apart, twist and hinge flat onto the ground (rotation side·(0.1·e1 + 1.05·e2), height × (1 − 0.66·e2²)); the card back darkens as it turns and a cream torn edge shows; fade over the last 28% of 0.35 s.

effects.name: Tissue crumple
effects.how: A tissue ghost’s thread snaps and whips up, the sheet scrunches to about a third of its size with a jittered double copy, then a crumpled tissue ball with crease facets drops to the ground and bounces once.

effects.name: Confetti and streamers
effects.how: Dots and strips in the seven accent colours, gravity 120, drag 2.4, sideways flutter; celebrations add 8 curly paper streamers trailing behind their flight, 6 folded paper stars (gold / teal) and a cut-card sunburst ring that snaps open and turns on twos for 0.85 s.

effects.name: Seed projectile
effects.how: A cut seed piece (#f4e8c6, brown rim) spinning, with a cream streak rgba(251,246,234,0.5) 1.6 wide and a thinner pumpkin streak 0.7 wide trailing 3–13 units behind.

effects.name: Dash copies and paper dust
effects.how: Three stacked cream card silhouettes of the current pose left 6.5 units apart (alpha 0.38 / 0.26 / 0.14), three torn cream speed strips and clumps of five torn paper flecks #e6d6b4 that spread and thin (no soft circles).

atmosphere.summary: One warm lamp at the top-left. Every shadow is a cool plum-brown rgb(44,24,34), falls right-down and grows with layer height. Glow exists only as additive halos over carved faces, lanterns and cores, flickering on twos. A warm brown vignette frames the screen; there is no colour grading, bloom or blur post-processing.
rules: Shadow offsets by height: puppet parts (0.42, 0.55), prop parts (0.55, 0.7), decals (0.45, 0.55), carpet leaves (0.6, 0.75), whole puppets (0.9, 1.1) blur 0.7 alpha 0.3, ground sheets (1.0–1.7, 1.3–2.2) blur 1.1–1.9.
Shadows are never black or grey: plum-brown rgb(44,24,34) at 0.2–0.6 alpha, warm per-channel multipliers on the ground (R × 0.86, G × 0.97, B × 1.0).

Contact blob under each character: radial rgba(44,24,34,0.62) → 0.36 @0.55 → 0, offset (+1.2, +0.6), alpha 0.75; sizes 9×3.6 (main character), 8.5×3.2 (small), 19×6 (large), 6.5×2.4 at 0.55 (ghost); it fades with the appear and tear-apart sequences.
Per-piece light: diagonal source-atop gradient rgba(255,250,232,a) → transparent @0.45 → rgba(50,25,10,1.2a), a ≈ 0.1.
Glow halos: 96 px radial sprite rgba(255,214,110,0.95) → rgba(255,170,60,0.45) @0.25 → rgba(240,110,30,0.12) @0.6 → 0, composited lighter at ~0.3 with a two-sine flicker sampled on twos.
Vignette: radial gradient centred at (0.45 W, 0.42 H), rgba(255,236,200,0.05) from 0.35R, rgba(70,40,20,0) at 0.6, rgba(60,30,15,0.36) at R (half the diagonal); cached per screen size.
Ambient motion is slow and stepped: trees rock ±0.014 rad, pinwheels spin, ghosts sway on their threads; nothing drifts across the screen.
No colour grading, bloom or post blur; the warmth lives in the palette and shadows.

ui.summary: The HUD is more craft material: bars are paper strips with a 3px cream rim and a warm offset shadow, slightly rotated (±0.4–2°), with a torn zig-zag right edge on the fill (main bar tomato red with cream polka dots, secondary bar diagonal teal stripes). Counters sit on cream sticker labels, the timer on lined notebook paper pinned with a brass split pin, cards on lined paper with striped washi tape at the top. Icons are small cut-paper pieces. Fonts are hand-lettered.

motion: Stop-motion timing: poses are held frames, and secondary motion (glow flicker, ghost bob and sway, prop rocking, starbursts, collectible hops) is sampled on a 12 fps clock on2(t) = floor(t·12)/12.

Main character walk: 8 held poses per stride (contact, down, passing, up, mirrored), frame = floor(anim / 5 · 8) & 7, i.e. one stride per 50 world units of travel (~15 poses/s at walking pace); throwing while walking swaps in the same 8 poses with the front arm raised to −2.05 / −2.3 rad.

Idle: 8 breathing poses at 5 fps (hip ±0.22, body squash ±2%, head and stem lagging the breath by 0.9 / 1.7 rad); every 5.5 s a 0.8 s fidget looks up over the shoulder in 4 poses with the stem flopping after the head.
Dash: anticipation crouch (first 35 ms) → stretched leap with the scarf streaming back → recover; standing throw: release pose then follow-through.

Small creatures waddle on 8 poses advanced by distance (frame = floor(anim·0.42·8)): the bulb rocks ±0.13 rad over the planted root, squashes x +7.5% / y −8.5% on each footfall and the leaves arrive one radian late; large creature 8 poses at rate 0.28 with a heavy landing and an arm whip.

Ghosts: 6 hem-flutter frames at 8 fps, a yo-yo bob −2.2 − 1.9·(0.5 + 0.5·sin t)^2.2 on twos, and a pendulum sway on their thread integrated in 1/12 s steps (spring 0.32, damping 0.24) that leans into movement and is kicked by hits.

Appear: card creatures slide out flat on a fold tab and hinge upright with easeOutBack (y-scale 0.06 → 1, x-scale overshoot 1.14, tilt 0.18); ghosts are lowered 34 units on their thread with an overshoot and fade in over the first third. Every creature has its own scale (0.93 + seed·0.14) and phase.

Hit (~140 ms, flash decays at 7/s): the figure is squashed against the blow (x +17%, y −15%) and knocked back 0.24 rad on its base, with the cream flash copy on top; ghosts swing away on their thread.

Destroyed: tear-apart (card) or crumple-and-drop (tissue) over 0.35 s; main character hurt pose for 0.18 s, then blinks on twos (alpha 0.5 every other 1/12 s) while invulnerable; celebration squash sy = 1 + sin(on2(T)·14)·T·0.12, sx = 2 − sy, with T running 1 → 0 over 0.67 s.
Collectibles hop on twos (quick lift, slow settle) and fake a paper turn (x-scale 0.35 + 0.65·|cos(2.2t)|); orbiting lanterns bob on twos and trail behind their orbit like a pendulum (±0.2 rad).
do: Build every object from separate flat cut pieces and give each one the cream rim, grain, top-left light and its own offset shadow.
Keep all shadows plum-brown and offset to the right-down; layer depth = shadow offset size.
Animate like stop-motion: held poses on twos, 4 key poses per step, parts that lag (head one pose, scarf and stem two).
Give every state its own paper action: pop-up cards for entrances, a squash-and-knock-back for hits, tearing or crumpling for exits.
Compose the ground: one path that leads somewhere, props in small groups with baked litter, flowers in drifts.
Show material edges: torn white fibre cores, sheet side thickness, corrugation flutes, stitch lines.
Pre-bake every animation frame and ground chunk; per-frame work is only drawImage.
Let faces be cut-out holes with warm light behind them; put brass split pins on visible joints.
dont: Don’t draw black or dark ink outlines — the cream rim and shadows separate shapes.
Don’t use smooth 3D gradients for volume; stack flat layers instead.
Don’t use grey or black shadows, or shadows pointing in different directions.
Don’t bend or morph pieces; puppets rotate rigid parts, and squash is limited to a few percent on a whole piece.
Don’t tween everything smoothly at 60 fps — floaty interpolation breaks the hand-moved puppet feel.
Don’t sprinkle decals evenly or fade figures out; group them, and tear or crumple disappearing figures.
Don’t leave pieces without grain — clean vector fills immediately look digital.
Don’t blur or rim per frame at runtime; it is far too expensive.
performance: All pieces (dilated rim, grain, light, blurred shadow) and all animation frames are baked once at init: about 130 puppet frames (main character 68, small creatures 32, ghosts 12, golem 16) plus props, decals and effect sprites. The ground is the hot spot: per-pixel shading over 5 signed-distance layers with shadow look-ups, baked into 256-unit chunks asynchronously with generator yields and capped at 2.5 px/unit; path stones, fringes, flower drifts and prop litter are baked into the same chunk. Per frame only drawImage of chunks and sprites, clipped blits for the 0.35 s tear-apart, a 3-segment thread per ghost, a few additive glows and particles.
